[DE|Local] BR24 Thema des Tages (Bayern) (Tue 19:00): Wohin mit dem Atommüll: Bundesgesellschaft für Endlagersuche hält an möglichen bayerischen Standorten fest
item.description:
Originally published Tue 27 Oct 2026 19:00 IST.
Die Bundesgesellschaft für Endlagerung (BGE) hat zwar das Granitgestein im Fichtelgebirge und die Tonschichten in Schwaben inzwischen ausgeschlossen. Orte mit Granitformationen im Bayerischen Wald und in der Oberpfalz werden aber weiter geprüft. Bayerns Umweltminister Glauber nennt die Regionen "ungeeignet". Moderation: Theresia GrawGesprächspartner: BR-Experte Lorenz Storch

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Tue 18:30): Huge turnout in Israeli election
item.description:
Originally published Tue 27 Oct 2026 18:30 IST.

Israelis turn out in large numbers to vote in what many view as one of the most pivotal elections in the country's history. The campaign has been shaped by the issues of democracy and security and is widely being seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu's leadership.

Also: Officials aligned with the Rapid Support Forces in Sudan say drone strikes on the city of Nyala have killed over a hundred people. A ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine is holding in the Russia-occupied city of Oleshky, to allow in humanitarian aid. Media groups in India have told the country's supreme court that the government’s new privacy law would challenge the entire concept of news and amount to pre-censorship. The US Justice Department is set to file new charges against James Comey, marking the third time in just over a year that the Trump administration has tried to prosecute the former FBI director. Football star Kylian Mbappe has been dropped by two of his Chinese sponsors after a video emerged of the player making fun of China’s revolutionary hero Mao Zedong. As the sixth instalment in Sarah J. Mass’s ACOTAR series is released, we learn why the romantasy genre has become so popular. And finally, a two-metre-tall skeleton of a dinosaur is expected to sell at Southby’s for $9m.

The Global News Podcast brings you the breaking news you need to hear, as it happens. Listen for the latest headlines and current affairs from around the world. Politics, economics, climate, business, technology, health – we cover it all with expert analysis and insight.
